about: The Snapka Law Firm, Injury & Malpractice Lawyers is a personal injury firm with offices in Corpus Christi, San Antonio and Harlingen.

The firm states that the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock. It publishes material in English and Spanish. It does not state a fee model on its public pages, so none is recorded here.

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. G1.evidence: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Texas does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: No matching entity on the Texas list of active franchise taxpayers. Texas does not require a sole proprietorship or a general partnership to pay franchise tax, and an exempt entity is left off as well, so this is a check this source cannot complete rather than evidence against the firm. The state's own SOSDirect service can settle it for a fee

G3.unresolvable: Texas lists only active franchise taxpayers, so a firm that is not obliged to be one cannot be found here however often we look

json_ld_descriptions: The Snapka Law Firm specializes in medical malpractice, pharmaceutical injury, and medical product liability cases. With offices in San Antonio, Corpus Christi, Harlingen, and San Diego, our experienced team provides compassionate representation to clients who have suffered due to medical negligence. Led by Board Certified attorney Kathryn Snapka, our firm has secured substantial recoveries for clients nationwide. We combine extensive medical knowledge with a personal approach, ensuring clients receive the experienced representation and support they deserve throughout their case, with special focus on Wernicke's Encephalopathy and serious injury litigation across Texas and beyond.
